create-titled-presentation.description: Create a new presentation, set theme, and add a title slide
steps: make new document with properties {document theme: theme id '...' of application 'Keynote'}
set object text of default title item of slide 1 to 'Title'
set object text of default body item of slide 1 to 'Subtitle'

batch-slide-deck.description: Create a multi-slide deck from a data list
steps: repeat with data: make new slide, set title/body

add-data-table.description: Add a table to a slide and populate it
steps: make new table with {position, row count, column count} in slide N
set value of cell C of row R of table 1 to 'header'

set-auto-advance-slideshow.description: Configure slides to auto-advance and loop
steps: set transition properties of each slide to {transition effect:dissolve, automatic transition:true}
set auto play of document to true
set auto loop of document to true

errors.error: Can't make {x:100, y:200} into type point (-1700)
errors.cause: Using record notation {x:100, y:200} for position/size
errors.fix: Use list notation {100, 200} for position; set width and height separately for size

errors.error: Can't set size of shape N to {w, h} (-10006)
errors.cause: Setting size as a list in one step
errors.fix: Set width and height as separate properties: 'set width of shape to 200' then 'set height of shape to 150'

errors.error: Can't get theme id '...' of document 1 (-1728)
errors.cause: Accessing theme by ID from document scope
errors.fix: Get theme from application scope: 'theme id "..." of application "Keynote"'

errors.error: Can't make string into type document (-1700) when setting password
errors.cause: AppleScript cannot set password property directly
errors.fix: Password setting is UI-only via File > Set Password... dialog

errors.error: Can't make none into type constant (-1700) for transition effect
errors.fix: Use 'no transition effect' as the keyword for no transition

errors.error: Expected ',' or '}' but found ':' (-2741) in transition properties
errors.cause: Using abbreviated key names like 'duration:' instead of full names
errors.fix: Use full property names: 'transition duration', 'transition delay', 'transition effect', 'automatic transition'

errors.cause: Attempting to export as QuickTime movie
errors.fix: Video export not supported via AppleScript in current Keynote version. Use File > Export To > Movie via UI.

errors.error: Security filter blocked: string concatenation containing 'script'
errors.cause: ScreenHand security filter blocks AppleScript with 'script' in concatenated strings
errors.fix: Avoid concatenating the word 'script' in string expressions. Restructure to use separate variables.

errors.error: Can't get name of slide N (-1728)
errors.cause: Slides in Keynote don't have a 'name' property
errors.fix: Use 'slide number' for identifier, 'object text of default title item' for the title text
